# Atlas (2024 film)
**Atlas (2024)** is a science fiction action film released on Netflix on May 24, 2024, starring Jennifer Lopez as Atlas Shepherd. Set in 2071, the story follows Atlas, a military analyst and the daughter of the creator of a humanoid AI terrorist named Harlan, who is leading a war against humanity from a planet in the Andromeda Galaxy. To stop Harlan's plan to use stolen carbon bombs to burn the Earth's atmosphere, Atlas joins an International Coalition of Nations (ICN) mission to capture him. During the descent to the planet, Atlas is forced to interface her mind with an onboard AI, Smith, and pilot an Advanced Robotics Construct (ARC) mecha. Despite initial distrust and the loss of her squad, Atlas and Smith develop a bond as they journey to Harlan's base, eventually reactivating Smith and upgrading it to defeat the AI forces in a hand-to-hand combat sequence.
The film, written by Leo Sardarian with rewrites by Aron Eli Coleite, features a cast including Simu Liu as Harlan, Sterling K. Brown as Colonel Elias Banks, and Mark Strong as General Jake Boothe. Principal photography took place in Los Angeles and New Zealand, wrapping in November 2022. While the film received critical acclaim for its visual effects and action sequences, it was poorly received by critics for its script and pacing, earning a 19% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Despite the negative reviews, the film was a massive success on streaming platforms, accumulating 60 million global views within a month of its release and topping Netflix's charts in 71 countries.
